scope: Native source triangles (shell, rooms, fixtures, planting, coast) plus the streamed furniture items placed exactly as furniture.mjs places them. Delivered Draco geometry of the repaired families is checked separately in test/coastal-overlap-delivered.test.mjs; browser poses of people and animals are separate captured evidence.

contactRules.test: deepest mutual penetration at the site <= 4 mm
contactRules.reason: Touching solids within compression and bevel tolerance; the seam reads as a contact at every supported camera distance.

contactRules.test: one side is a water surface
contactRules.reason: A water surface meets its own basin walls, steps and rim at the waterline.

contactRules.test: plant geometry inside rock, ground, soil, a planter or a floor, no deeper than max(45 mm, 20% of the plant part's height), every inside sample in the part's lowest 30% (or 25 cm)
contactRules.reason: Stems, trunks and leaf bases rooted in soil, mulch, rock or a planter; on a slope the uphill side of a shrub or trunk sits deeper (the agave contract embeds rosettes 22 mm).
Sand, sandstone, haul-out rocks and the mainland meet where one landform emerges from another; there is no inhabited surface between them.

contactRules.test: >= 60% of the host's crossed faces face up; every inside sample within 6 cm of the resting part's lowest point
contactRules.reason: An item resting on a floor, tread, shelf, counter or ground: only its base sits in the upward support, hiding compression gaps.

contactRules.test: the host's crossed faces all face one way (normal coherence >= 0.8) and at most 25% of the penetrating part's extent along that normal is hidden
contactRules.reason: A fixture, cabinet, frame, hood, shelf or panel set into the wall, ceiling or block it is fixed to: the hidden end never emerges elsewhere, so the visible result is a flush contact.

contactRules.test: the penetrating part is slender (<= 9 cm in two axes and >= 3x longer)
contactRules.reason: A post, baluster, column, leg, rung or rod seated into the rail, tread, slab or frame it joins; its end is hidden inside that member.

exclusions.reason: Shadow-only copies and render-hidden geometry are never drawn in the beauty pass.
A collision proxy hidden as soon as its streamed furniture item is placed; the item itself is audited at its anchor.
Only one of the six made/fitted bedding variants is shown at a time; variants are audited against everything else.
Soft leaf, grass and petal cards interleave like real foliage; plant-to-plant pairs are counted, not ranked.
